story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Mason, and Lucas. "Lucas is an angel and Lucas is a devil," Mason claimed. Lucas said that if Mason is a devil then Mason is an angel. So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Mason is a angel/devil, and Lucas is a angel/devil")

options: Mason is an angel, Lucas is an angel
Mason is an angel, Lucas is a devil
Mason is a devil, Lucas is a devil
Mason is a devil, Lucas is an angel
